फंक्शन्स अनेक, वेंडर एक — WOWsters Planners

Weddings that make every single guest say wow.

WOWsters Planners is a wedding and event planning house from Chandigarh — planning, in-house décor and destination weddings all over India, led personally by founder Chandni Sharma since 2007.

Plan your celebration
सेवाएँWHAT WE DO

One team for every function — from the first haldi to the vidaai.

Since 2007 we have planned celebrations end-to-end: venues, in-house décor, vendors, cuisine, entertainment and the hundred invisible details in between — always within the budget we agree on together.

Full Wedding Planning

शादी

Mehndi, haldi, jaago, ring ceremony, pheras and reception — multi-day weddings planned as one continuous story, with every vendor under a single roof.

Destination Weddings

डेस्टिनेशन

Heritage properties in the hills, palaces in Rajasthan, beaches in Goa — anywhere in India. We coordinate between your city and the venue so it all feels effortless.

In-House Décor

सजावट

Our own décor unit designs mandaps, stages, florals and lighting to your taste and budget — and we work happily alongside outside decorators if you have one in mind.

Vendors & Entertainment

मनोरंजन

Qawwali troupes, dhol and band-baja-ghodi, anchors, mehndi and makeup artists, chaat stalls and more — sourced, negotiated and managed by our team.

संस्थापकTHE WOMAN BEHIND THE WOW

Chandni Sharma

Founder & Lead Planner

दिल से काम — work that comes from the heart

Chandni has been planning weddings and celebrations from Chandigarh since 2007. Clients describe her the same way again and again: warm with families, calm under pressure, and fiercely protective of your budget.

She has taken sprawling heritage properties in the hills and made them run like clockwork, and she has pulled together complete multi-day weddings on timelines other planners would refuse. If she is handling your event, problems get solved before you ever hear about them.

तरीक़ाHOW A WOWSTERS WEDDING COMES TOGETHER

Four movements, like any good composition.

१

Baithak

We sit down over chai and listen — your families, your rituals, the songs that must play, the ones that must not.

२

Kalpana

A complete design: venue, palette, florals, cuisine and a minute-by-minute guest journey, presented as a single illustrated book.

३

Taiyari

Our production team contracts artisans, mandap-makers, chefs and musicians across India, and rehearses every transition.

४

Utsav

On the days themselves you are a guest at your own celebration. We run the show; you hold the moment.
